provenance: Codex subagent review of immutable prepared inputs; findings checked against source, separate from deterministic validation.
rationale: WellFormed contains object/variable-key uniqueness, declared shapes with ordered distinct fields, index bounds, older field targets, References Nodup and References membership iff Allocated. References concatenates occupied variables and fields, so Nodup plus iff is exactly one owning occurrence per allocated object and no missing target. WellFormedWith adds pending IDs to that same accounting, matching the evaluation qualification. Notation and premises are supplied by the examined units given.allocated, given.classes, given.collections, given.evaluation, given.identities, given.lookup, given.programs, given.resolution, given.slots, given.state, given.storage_places, given.syntax, given.update.
limitations: This compares the authored statement/definition/example with the selected formalization. It does not independently recheck Lean proof tactics or attest to a compiler run.
